vehicle_geometries.selection_contract: same-frame vehicle mask resized by nearest neighbor to the dense InfiniDepth source grid; one surface Gaussian per pixel; opacity gate; no 3D-uniform resampling, PLY serialization, or PLY reprojection
vehicle_geometries.geometry_relation_to_legacy_ply: same InfiniDepth dense depth, DINO features, Gaussian predictor, camera intrinsics, and world transform; dense source-pixel sampling replaces legacy 3D-uniform resampling, so a regression gate is required
